name: widemark
description: Compact Chrome bookmark side panel extension for browsing, search, organization, styling, and local duplicate checks.

scripts.validate: node --check src/background.js && node --check src/bookmark-utils.js && node --check src/ui-icons.js && node --check src/bookmark-tree-controller.js && node --check src/duplicate-renderer.js && node --check src/duplicate-finder-controller.js && node --check src/modal-dialog.js && node --check src/context-menu-controller.js && node --check src/settings-controller.js && node --check src/sidepanel.js && node --check scripts/package-extension.js && node --check scripts/generate-store-assets.js
scripts.build: echo 'Building Chrome Extension...' && npm run package && ./scripts/sync-to-windows.sh
scripts.package: npm run check && npm test && node scripts/package-extension.js
